# Geometry cache
Cached mesh geometry must be invalidated when a new original revision replaces source content. A cache key includes the item revision.

# Physics collision stages
Broadphase bounding volumes prune candidate pairs. Narrowphase computes contact intersections for remaining collision shapes.
The separating axis test verifies triangle overlap. A contact manifold retains stable collision normals for regression scenarios.

# Elevation guide
A heightmap stores elevation for hills and slopes. Cliff atlas metadata indexes rock formations by zone.

# Material projection
Triplanar projection blends splatmaps and surface normals for mountainous shading.

# Terrain materials
A cliff tile palette maps material identifiers to texture images. Do not confuse palette data with geometry.
public sealed class VertexUpload { void UploadVertexBuffer() { /* stream vertices to the GPU before issuing draw calls */ } }

# Indexed drawing
An index buffer stores triangle element positions. Bind the index buffer after configuring vertex attributes.

# Sprite ordering
Stable tick precedence breaks ties in the depth sort after overlapping bounds are compared.

# Visibility
Frustum culling excludes offscreen render objects. Spatial buckets limit the visible candidate scan.

# Session admission
The handshake nonce guards the initial authenticated session against replayed greetings.

# Admission renewal
An admission token expires before renewal and must be scoped to one authorized account.

# Message framing
Sequence counters and stream nonces are validated separately from packet parsing.

# Version fencing
A revision fence makes superseded document text ineligible for search even before its replacement is processed.

# Source revocation
A revoked source must not contribute search results, cached snippets or derived embeddings after revocation.

# Integrity check
The sha256 digest identifies original bytes but cannot prove those bytes still exist at a stored path.

# Resume processing
Failed jobs retain an attempt count and an explicit retry decision. Restarting a worker must not claim an active lease twice.

# Build validation
Run dotnet build in Release configuration before executing tests on rebuilt assemblies.

# Release verification
A smoke test confirms startup, clean shutdown, and the expected catalog schema before deployment.
